kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتعارض (form VI)
# نَتَعَارَضُ (nataʕāraḍu) /na.ta.ʕaː.ra.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَعَارَضَ (taʕāraḍa)
# نَتَعَارَضَ (nataʕāraḍa) /na.ta.ʕaː.ra.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَعَارَضَ (taʕāraḍa)
# نَتَعَارَضْ (nataʕāraḍ) /na.ta.ʕaː.radˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَعَارَضَ (taʕāraḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
